note: CUT 58130 -> 56277 (-1853: schema -1532, harness -321) by SHIPPING D288 — the operator's 'convert fully' of 2026-11-14: `llm` and `decide` stopped being action kinds, so every run's always-on contract lost their two kind bullets (harness) and, in the schema, the four field definitions only they took (`system`, `response_schema`, `answer_type`, `files`) plus their clauses in the six they SHARED (`prompt`, `question`, `questions`, `options`, `evidence`, `model`, `handle`, `background`) — a shared field's clause set is held equal to its accepting-kind set by tests/test_kindsurface.py, so the trims are required rather than optional. PREVIOUS: RAISED 59057 -> 59181 (+124: harness +38, schema +86) for the Hermes-derived past-run SEARCH (0.572.0, engine/runsearch.py): `memory_read` with `args` (words) instead of a `name` searches the routine's earlier transcripts. A run that is not told the search exists cannot use it, and the two places it must be told are the ones this budget meters: the `args` field description, which tests/test_kindsurface.py requires to name EVERY kind that accepts the field (so memory_read's clause is a requirement of the projection, not a choice), and the memory kind bullet, whose conduct line 'consult it before re-discovering anything' now says WHERE else to look ('— or search your past runs (`args`) —', 38 chars). Everything else the feature says — the hit format, the ALL-then-ANY fallback, the zero-hit query hint — lives in the OBSERVATION, which only a run that searches pays for. The other four mechanisms of 0.572.0 (the review leg, note-read counts, loop-shape warnings, shell exit attribution) add nothing here: each speaks only in an observation tail, an engine note or a finish line, on the turns it applies to. AND IT WORKS AGAINST b5 (the ~90% prompt cut), stated rather than left to be discovered: b5 has cut 51,429 chars/turn so far and this adds back 124, i.e. 0.24% of that gain.
